sasha: Heads up — nightly gpu-smoke on hetero nodes turned red after an opportunistic preempt. warmup task OOMs and I see `invalid device function` in the container log :eyes:
elaine: Thanks. Can you paste the CI job id and node hostname?
sasha: job=ci-nightly/4532, node=prod-gpu-12. Quick paste from the warmup log:
```
[2026-03-17T04:12:33Z] warmup: allocating kv cache
[2026-03-17T04:12:37Z] cuda: INVALID_DEVICE_FUNCTION
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::runtime_error'
  what():  CUDA driver version is insufficient for runtime
```
matt: Sounds like a host/container driver skew. Can you run `nvidia-smi` on the node and show the container driver version (if possible)? :thinking_face:
sasha: grabbed node `nvidia-smi` output from cloud console:
```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| NVIDIA-SMI 525.85.12    Driver Version: 525.85.12    CUDA Version: 12.1 |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```
But inside the container the runtime reports expecting 515 (from the libcuda symbols). I'm suspecting the node got a rolling driver update mid-job (opportunistic maintenance).
jin: If the host driver changed during the job, the kernel module might not match the container's expectations. Check `/var/log/kern.log` around the time for module reloads or `modprobe` entries.
sasha: quick `dmesg | grep -i nvidia` showed a module unload/load at 04:11:50 which lines up with the job start.
elaine: I'm going to pin this to infra oncall and retag the PR to force a rerun on a stable canary pool. @matt can you try a targeted rerun with the pinned image `gpu-warmup:driver-525`? :thumbsup:
matt: Yep, I'll queue a canary rerun and try a bisect if it repros. Planning steps:
- rerun on canary-gpu pool
- if repro, run a quick binary that prints `cudaGetDeviceProperties` in both host and container contexts to compare ABI
- if mismatch confirmed, open infra bug and roll back opportunistic driver roll or pin nodes
infra-bot: Rerun queued: https://ci.redwood.internal/ci-nightly/4532/reruns/1 (canary-gpu pool)
sasha: Thanks all. If canary passes I'll close this thread; if it flakes I'll attach kernel logs and request a formal bisect. Also cc @jin for kernel log followup. :white_check_mark:
